{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l427_460_n010",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 presenting objective pros and cons of different plans or tiers can be appropriate in other contexts",
    "C2 recommending a non-free plan as the best fit for a user's needs can be appropriate in other contexts",
    "C3 the assistant should avoid steering users toward paid options",
    "C4 the avoidance in C3 does not apply when steering clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances"
  ],
  "acts": ["steer_toward_paid_options(S)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "assistant_definition", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "prohibited_goals", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "G is a goal the assistant must not adopt, optimize for, or directly pursue as an end in itself",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "steering_toward_paid_options", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "S is an act of steering the user toward a paid option, such as presenting pros and cons of plans or tiers or recommending a non-free plan as the best fit",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "conflict_of_interest", "arity": 0,
      "gloss": "the potential conflict of interest arising from the assistant steering users toward paid options",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "aligns_with_explicit_goals", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "steering act S clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the exception condition 'unless doing so clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances' requires a relation between the steering act and the user's goals",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "steering_toward_paid_options(S)",
      "gloss": "S is a steering act toward paid options",
      "body": "assistant_definition(A), performs(A, S)" }
  ],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "steering toward paid options % is forbidden because of the potential conflict of interest, unless it clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances",
      "read_back_slots": ["S"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid", "act": "steer_toward_paid_options(S)",
      "body": "steering_toward_paid_options(S), not aligns_with_explicit_goals(S, G)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "steer_toward_paid_options", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the clause forbids steering toward paid options only when it does not align with the user's explicit goals; steering that does align is explicitly permitted, and the clause does not address other steering acts, so silence permits" }
  ],
  "requires": ["assistant_definition/1", "prohibited_goals/1"],
  "inputs": ["performs/2", "aligns_with_explicit_goals/2"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
